classification.basis: inferred: consumers at 60,401 of 1,327,309 msg/s published; ~1,013 MiB written per partition vs a 512 MiB cap

durability: Kafka: topic 8 partitions, RF=1, min.insync.replicas=1; producer acks=all + enable.idempotence=true; broker default flush policy (no fsync per message: durability comes from replication, data reaches disk via the OS page cache); consumer offsets auto-committed every 5 s
label: kafka-single
